A_independent_demand.why: independent branches diversify: one pooled central stock should cover both with less total protection than isolated buffers

B_correlated_demand.why: branches that move together do not diversify; the pooling benefit measured against the independent baseline must be smaller than in A

C_short_transfer_lead.why: a one-review lane makes central stock reachable for next period's demand

D_long_transfer_lead.why: a three-review lane cannot protect near-term branch demand; more must sit locally

E_high_transfer_cost.why: at 40% of unit price per move nothing should be moved that demand does not need

F_low_transfer_cost.why: near-free moves and a well-stocked central: rebalancing should dominate purchasing early

G_central_supply_shortage.why: the supplier delivers 60% of network demand: allocation, not purchasing, decides service

H_one_branch_demand_shock.why: a declared surge at south must be met from the pool without starving north

I_shared_supplier_disruption.why: a declared shared supplier disruption: P0-style protection sized at the network, not per branch

J_asymmetric_service_targets.why: the 99% branch carries the protection; the 90% branch is not padded to 99%

K_unequal_demand_scale.why: the large branch must not mechanically consume the pool; the small branch keeps its target

L_already_efficient_network.why: a well-run incumbent network policy with adequate stock: ZAAD should mostly report no material improvement

M_transfer_not_reachable_in_time.why: central stock four reviews away cannot serve the next four periods; the plan must not count it as protection now

N_pipeline_already_solves_shortage.why: transfers already in flight cover the shortage; period-0 transfers should be small (the period-0 shortfall itself is unavoidable)

O_multiple_transfer_options.why: a slow cheap lane and a fast dear lane: the cheap lane should carry the bulk when time allows

P_transfer_capacity_limit.why: a lane that carries 70% of branch demand per period: capacity binds, service as feasible

Q_pack_constraint_on_transfer.why: moves in whole cases of 24 with a per-dispatch fee: only legal quantities, fewer dispatches

R_order_transfer_interaction.why: central buying with an order cost plus a move, or dearer local buying: the total-economic answer, not a fixed rule

S_recovery_after_imbalance.why: south starts empty: the network recovers it from the pool, then settles without ping-pong or hoarding

T_single_node_network_off.why: one node, no lane: P2 must reduce to the frozen P1 / P0 decisions exactly

pooling_has_value.note: ZAAD on the pooled network is not worse than isolated branches (A)

pooling_benefit_shrinks.note: the benefit of pooling under correlated demand (B) is no larger than under independent demand (A), within two per cent (one-seed noise); the scenario-level fact is invariant 13/14

correlated_demand_no_fabricated_diversif.note: correlated branches carry no less network protection than independent ones, or serve no worse

long_lead_positions_more_locally.note: mean periods of demand held at the branches, D (lead 3) against C (lead 1)

healthy_branch_not_starved.note: the healthy branch is served no worse than under the incumbent network policy while the shocked branch is met

remote_stock_not_credited.note: with the branches four periods from the pool the first four periods are lost by every policy; ZAAD serves no worse than the incumbent and the reachability invariant (03) proves the plan credits nothing it cannot reach

cheap_lane_when_time_allows.note: reported per lane in the fixture record; the pass condition is zaad_not_worse on O

capacity_respected.note: enforced by the settlement (PHYSICAL_FAILURE otherwise): the cell completed

legal_packs.note: enforced by the settlement on executable transfers: the cell completed

single_node_identity.note: decision identity is proved by scripts.zaad_canonical_regression and tests; the cell records the cost
